2609.19076.title: Double descent is the principle of least action
2609.19076.paper_summary: The test error of a model plotted against its number of parameters $d$ falls, peaks when the model can just fit the training data, and falls again, exhibiting the double descent phenomenon. We explain the phenomenon with statistical mechanics. The training trajectory of a stochastic gradient-based method is a particle wandering over the energy landscape of the training loss at an induced temperature $T$, and a run that has equilibrated visits every parameter vector of a given training loss equally often, the fundamental postulate of statistical mechanics, with probability given by the Boltzmann distribution. Because training starts at an initial point and has only finite time to diffuse, it carries an effective weight decay, which makes every parameter a quadratic degree of freedom. The equipartition theorem then distributes the energy among the $d$ degrees of freedom in shares of $T/2$, so at a fixed training loss adding parameters lowers the temperature and drives the Boltzmann distribution toward the stationary path. Finally, adding parameters can only lower the $L^2$ norm of the stationary path, so a solution sampled at fixed loss is less likely to be large with increasing $d$, effectively increasing weight regularization.
2609.19076.paper_summary_zh: 模型的測試錯誤與其參數數量 $d$ 的關係圖呈現下降趨勢，當模型剛好能擬合訓練數據時達到峰值，然後再次下降，顯示出雙重下降現象。 我們用統計力學來解釋這一現象。 基於隨機梯度的方法的訓練軌跡就像是一個粒子在訓練損失的能量景觀上隨機遊走，溫度為 $T$，而一個已經達到平衡的運行會以相等的頻率訪問給定訓練損失的每個參數向量，這是統計力學的基本假設，概率由玻爾茲曼分佈給出。 因為訓練是從一個初始點開始的，並且只有有限的時間進行擴散，它攜帶了一個有效的權重衰減，這使得每個參數成為一個二次自由度。 然後，等分配定理將能量在 $d$ 個自由度之間分配，每個自由度的能量為 $T/2$，因此在固定的訓練損失下，增加參數會降低溫度並驅動玻爾茲曼分佈朝向穩定路徑。 最後，增加參數只能降低穩定路徑的 $L^2$ 範數，因此在固定損失下抽樣的解隨著 $d$ 的增加而不太可能變得很大，有效地增加了權重正則化。
